classification.difficultyReason: Choose area and perimeter formulas for each shape and compare their numerical results in the displayed units to identify the exception.

content.prompt: Which of these shapes does NOT have the same numerical value for its area (in square units) and perimeter (in length units), using the units shown?

spec.sourceRegion: Question 8, first shape from the left
spec.description: Wide horizontal rectangle with 9 m above its top edge and 2.5 m beside its right edge.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied dimensions are visible; no calculated area or perimeter.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 8, second shape from the left
spec.description: Tall vertical rectangle with 6 cm beside its left edge and 3 cm below its bottom edge.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied dimensions are visible; no calculated area or perimeter.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 8, third shape from the left
spec.description: Square with 4 mm above its top edge and 4 mm beside its right edge.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied dimensions are visible; no calculated area or perimeter.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 8, fourth shape from the left
spec.description: Triangle with vertical left side 8 m, horizontal base 6 m and sloping side 10 m. No right-angle marker is printed.
spec.mathematics: The perpendicular base and height are 6 m and 8 m; the three sides are 6 m, 8 m and 10 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied dimensions are visible; no calculated area or perimeter.

answer.worked:
First rectangle:
$$\begin{align*}A &= 9\times2.5 = 22.5\,\mathrm{m}^2\\P &= 2(9+2.5) = 23\,\mathrm{m}\end{align*}$$
Second rectangle:
$$\begin{align*}A &= 6\times3 = 18\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\P &= 2(6+3) = 18\,\mathrm{cm}\end{align*}$$
Square:
$$\begin{align*}A &= 4\times4 = 16\,\mathrm{mm}^2\\P &= 4\times4 = 16\,\mathrm{mm}\end{align*}$$
Triangle:
$$\begin{align*}A &= \frac{6\times8}{2} = 24\,\mathrm{m}^2\\P &= 6+8+10 = 24\,\mathrm{m}\end{align*}$$
Only the first rectangle has different numerical values for its area and perimeter: $22.5$ and $23$.
